name: sol10-reuse
goal: Consolidate shared behavior and primitives while preserving contracts and evidence

evidence: Use canonical helpers and shared primitives; retain source identities, complete contracts, status visuals and side-bound comparison metadata.
Shared helpers, aliases, Card, comparisons, tables, lists, status and messages are consolidated. Reuse allowance is sealed at zero; native wrappers remain compiler inputs.
Focused workloads and guards passed 171 cases. Immutable comparison and mobile red-green pairs are retained; the initial hosted-binding failure is reproduced at c26676a169.
